hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for Vladdy native-ETH/TOKEN pools. Takes all swap fees in ETH (configured 1–5% rate, immutable per pool) and distributes them per-swap to a platform wallet, configured recipients, and/or a buyback-and-burn reserve. Supports an optional stock-rewards mode where the non-platform fee share accrues to a reserve spent buying a stock token deposited into a distributor contract.
